text:
zane: Quick dump — FP8 enable on H100/L40S shows weird throughput variance across batch sizes. p50 looks fine, but p95/p99 jump 2–3x for mid-tail. Sharing initial profiler notes and configs.

maria: which transformer-engine config are you using? kernel probing on/off? :eyes:

zane: transformer engine env: TRANSFORMER_ENGINE=1, TE_FP8=1, TE_CONFIG="fp8_recipe=default,amax_warmup=100", kernel_probe=auto. tests: seq_len=2048, batch sizes 1..16, kv cache hit ratio ~0.8. quick logs: 
```
nvprof: kernel conv_gemm_fp8 time 1.2ms
fallback kernel int8_gemm time 3.4ms
warning: small amax spikes -> quant overflow
```

aj: did you run with continuous batching? that changes KV cache behaviour — if prefix cache misses, latency balloons.

sana: saw NaNs on L40S when amax calibration didn't converge — had to bump amax interval to 200 steps to stabilize.

zane: confirmed. On H100 NaNs are rare but throughput regresses when kernel selection flips between te_fp8_gemm and fp32 fallback per layer during long sequences.

ryan: can you upload a flamegraph/profile? and which heuristic flips the kernel? seq_len threshold or head_dim divisibility?

zane: flamegraph uploaded to the thread (attached). Observed runtime picks TE kernel for heads where dim % 64 == 0, otherwise legacy. But TE's auto-tuner has timing noise: tiny perf differences cause different kernels to be chosen across requests -> jitter in p95.

maria: could we pin kernel selection per model version after warmup? record best kernel during calibration and lock it to avoid oscillation.

aj: we tried kernel_probe=warmup_only before — it helped tail, but some configs lost best-case throughput.

perf-bot: perf alert: p95 latency increase 74% after FP8 rollout on h100-pool-3 (since 1823456000) :rotating_light: 

sana: calibration idea: run deterministic calibration pass (single-threaded, fixed seed) at model load time before marking fp8 ready. avoid amax variance from nondeterministic warmup.

zane: agreed. Proposed plan:
- add deterministic calibration pass during model load (TE_CALIB_SEED=42, CALIB_STEPS=500)
- persist kernel_selection_lock flag per layer in model metadata
- tweak batching heuristic: if kernel_selection unstable, prefer batch grouping that keeps same kernel across batch (group by head_dim where possible)
- add telemetry: log kernel_id per request + per-layer amax time series

aj: I can prototype kernel_lock flag tomorrow.

maria: I'll add a smoke test to replay calibration on a small corpus and assert no NaNs and stable amax (<5% variance) across 10 runs.

ryan: also check KV cache eviction patterns — cache thrash due to batch permutations can change memory layout and trigger different kernel paths.

zane: noted. I'll run KV cache trace with batch permutations and attach results later.

sana: cc @eng-ml — might need per-channel amax or layer-specific quant tuning for problematic attention heads.

aj: :thumbsup: Will open PR for kernel_lock + deterministic calib.

zane: if you hit p95 spikes paste this log snippet in the thread to correlate: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:56Z] model=redwood/gpt-lite fp8_mode=on kernel=te_fp8_gemm layer=attn_7 p95=312.4ms fallback=0 amax=3.2
[2026-03-17T12:34:58Z] model=redwood/gpt-lite fp8_mode=on kernel=fp32_fallback layer=attn_7 p95=702.1ms fallback=1 amax=0.8
```

maria: added to ops runbook. Let's reconvene after aj's PR and two deterministic calibration runs.

aj: timeline acked — aiming to PR tomorrow and run 2x calib jobs on h100/l40s pool by EOD.

zane: thanks all — priority: stabilize tail before we widen rollout.
